ledger_mappings_group.value:

        when "ledger_mappings"."purpose" = 'payment_mode' then num_nonnulls("ledger_mappings"."rate_bps", "ledger_mappings"."nature", "ledger_mappings"."supply_type", "ledger_mappings"."party_id") = 0

      end

loyalty_ledger_points_sign.value:

        when 'redeem' then "loyalty_ledger"."points" < 0
        when 'expire' then "loyalty_ledger"."points" < 0
        when 'adjust' then "loyalty_ledger"."points" <> 0
        else "loyalty_ledger"."points" > 0 end

loyalty_ledger_purchase.name: loyalty_ledger_purchase
loyalty_ledger_purchase.value:
("loyalty_ledger"."kind" <> 'purchase' or num_nonnulls("loyalty_ledger"."manual_purchase_paise", "loyalty_ledger"."tax_document_id") = 1)
        and ("loyalty_ledger"."manual_purchase_paise" is null or ("loyalty_ledger"."kind" = 'purchase' and "loyalty_ledger"."manual_purchase_paise" > 0))
